trigger: Q3 FY2026 print 2026-11-03 after close: adj EPS 4.66 vs Street 4.48; GB +10%; $1.0B FTC charge (excluded from adjusted); Q4 guide RN +1-3%, GB +2-4%, adj EBITDA ~flat; Middle East disruption
what_changed: Q3 FY2026 actual vs our prediction (driver by driver; 10-Q 0001075531-26-000045): room nights 345M vs 339.2M (+1.7%); GB per room night $157.86 vs $155.67 (+1.4%; GB $54.46B vs $52.80B, +3.2%); take (adjusted revenue / GB) 17.98% vs 18.17% (-19bp); marketing 4.75% vs 4.79% of GB; core opex 28.22% vs 28.71% of revenue ($2,764M vs $2,754M); period-end shares 749M vs 746.2M; adjusted revenue $9,793M vs $9,593M (+2.1%); adjusted operating income (model basis) $4,441M vs $4,310M (+3.0%); adjusted EPS $4.66 vs ours $4.3709, Street $4.48, whisper $4.5275. What was wrong: (1) volume: we credited only half of management's guide-beat record and Q3 beat the full record again (RN +6.7% vs guide 3-5%), a systematic under-credit, not noise; (2) the take rate: we had it +3bp y/y and it fell 16bp (third quarter of compression; flights +19%), a driver set in the wrong direction; (3) the EPS bridge: about $0.10 of the $0.29 EPS gap is below the line, the build's 22.4% GAAP tax rate vs the 20.7% adjusted rate, plus ~$0.04 of intangible amortization the adjusted figure excludes; the rest (~$0.14) is the EBIT beat. FX was a ~1.4pt headwind on GB, as assumed; costs came in at plan in dollars. Q4 guide (RN +1-3%, GB +2-4%, adjusted revenue 0-2%, adj EBITDA about flat; Middle East disruption to year-end) is the weakest in the record but inside its normal range; with half the beat record we sit above the top-line ranges and at the EBITDA midpoint; Q4 adj EPS ~$2.06 vs Street $2.33 (pre-print), FY2026 ~$10.31 vs $10.48, FY2027 $11.99 (build) vs $12.35. Moves: take path cut to 14.28% flat in FY2027 (-$3.34), gbrn +$1.35, rn +$0.53, opex +$0.69, marketing +$0.39, shares -$0.94 (slower Q3 buyback; script's broken weighted-average roll replaced by period-end values), tax factor to the adjusted 20.9% +$0.65, FTC -$790M after tax -$1.12. Research target (12m) 189.24 -> 188.17 (-0.6%): horizon roll 10-23 -> 11-03 +$0.72 (old set at 11-03 = 189.96), update -$1.79. FTC: $900M revenue reduction + $100M accrued loss shown in the GAAP reported Q3 rows only; drivers exclude it (the filing excludes it from gross bookings and adjusted results); no settlement is agreed, so no forward take or marketing change; the cash (accrued, unpaid at 9/30) enters as an equity adjustment. REBUILD (owner review, same date): every forward driver year now rests on its own evidence, nothing carried over. Take: a decomposition of the y/y change (mix -1 to -5bp and fading, merchant rate +2bp median on payment rebates, agency rate -17 / -13bp in Q2-Q3 as agency bookings recover against revenue at check-in, advertising -1bp) gives flat in FY2027 and +0.5 / +1bp after, consistent with the company's 8% GB / 8% revenue framework; the decline is assumed to stop after Q4 FY2026 (a judgment call: continuing at -17bp/yr is -6.6%). Room nights +6.0% FY2027 (undisrupted 2026 pace), +5.4% FY2028-29 (framework / gbrn); gbrn +3.0% then +2.5% (cc ADR plus flights); marketing +4bp/yr (2026 median, SEO statement); core opex from clean cost drift less stated Transformation savings, with amortization held at the FY2025 level so the Q3 useful-life change no longer leaks into adjusted EPS; shares from FCF less dividends at today's P/E (-7.7%/yr vs -7.5% reported). Research target (12m) 188.17 -> 195.27 (+3.8%). GATE FIX 2026-11-04 (owner rule: every forecast year on its own evidence; where no evidence for a turn exists, extend the observed trend): Take: the FY2027 stop of the agency-rate decline rested on an inferred check-in lag that the filings contradict (agency rate -60bp in Q2 and -50bp in Q3 y/y while agency gross bookings were -3.1% / -3.3% / -1.3%; Q4 guide implies ~-28 to -31bp), so FY2027-29 now extend each decomposition leg at its observed trend: agency rate -55bp/yr x agency share 24.5 / 23.5 / 23.5% (-13.5 / -12.9 / -12.9bp), mix -1 / -0.5 / 0bp, merchant rate +2bp, advertising -1bp = -13.5 / -12.5 / -12bp a year; take 14.29% FY2026 -> 14.14% / 14.02% / 13.90%. Shares: buyback prices now scale with each year's own EPS ($177.92 / $200.28 / $225.11) and SBC issuance uses the 10-Q's 1.96%: 689.8 / 643.8 / 600.4M (-6.6 / -6.7 / -6.7%; was 681.9 / 628.9 / 579.3M); annual share change -0.067. SBC % revenue 0.021 -> 0.0196 (10-Q 9M 427 / 21,777); interest rate 0.055 -> 0.057, derived (9M interest 864 annualised / gross debt 20,061 = 5.74%), DCF diagnostic only. Framework guidance rows: one-record median applied (GB/revenue 0.0185 -> record-adjusted 0.10; EPS first guide 15%, median 0.0261 -> 0.18); FY2028 revenue +7.0% and EPS +12.6% now sit below the 8% / 15% framework. Alt-accommodation nights +4% confirmed in the Q2 release, CNMC $472M confirmed in the Q2 10-Q; the Muse 2.5M downloads relabelled an unsourced outlet estimate. Research target (12m) 195.27 -> 185.90 (-4.8%): shares and SBC -$2.96, take -$6.41.
escalate_review: None holds. Research target (12m) -0.6% (threshold ~10%). Q4 guide is soft but not withdrawn and inside its normal range (Q2 FY2026 guide was RN +2-4%, GB +4-6%). After-hours about -2% vs an implied move of 7.4% (well under 2x). FTC: an accrual of $1.0B on a matter the Q2 10-Q already disclosed (staff recommending a complaint), with no settlement agreed and the conduct remedy limited to Priceline's US practices: a quantified step in a known matter, not a shift that changes the business; watch for terms beyond the accrual or follow-on claims in other jurisdictions.
